subject.title: fix(browser): allow one retry after transient failures

question: Should the browser client recommend one retry for every classified transient transport/HTTP failure, or only for browser-control requests whose retry safety is established?
rationale: The intended distinction is product-sensitive because a transport failure can occur after an operation reaches the browser service, and the protected label requires an explicit maintainer decision rather than automated handling.

options.title: Confirm retry-safe scope and land
options.body: Confirm the browser-client callers covered by this hint are safe to retry once after an ambiguous transient failure, then land after final checks and real-runtime evidence are available.

options.title: Narrow the transient guidance
options.body: Restrict retry-once guidance to request shapes with known idempotency and leave ambiguous browser-control failures neutral.

options.title: Keep persistent guidance
options.body: Retain the current no-retry behavior if the model-facing hint cannot safely distinguish completed from uncompleted browser operations.

recommendation.title: Confirm retry-safe scope and land
recommendation.body: Confirm the browser-client callers covered by this hint are safe to retry once after an ambiguous transient failure, then land after final checks and real-runtime evidence are available.
